title: Northern Virginia and Space Coast annual readings join their Atlas pages
summary: Two exact September-assessed narratives now lead their canonical Atlas pages. Transmission, tariff, policy, site licence and mission evidence retain separate scopes and dates.
evidence_note: Local integration of six sections and six paragraphs only; no fresh external inspection. The Atlas file appointment now uses the latest independent file follow-up, not the earlier renewal receipt or a related policy date.
publication_effect: No new counted identities or operating admissions: eligibility remains 100 projects and 70 places. Source acceptance, production verification, release, owner launch and actual stewardship remain separate.
